page_title: The Most Realistic AI Headshot Generator | MyPicNow

sources.entry: MyPicNow - Generate studio-quality AI headshots of yourself. Perfect for LinkedIn, dating apps, and professional use.

summary.name: MyPicNow
summary.one_liner: MyPicNow is an AI headshot generator that creates studio-style portrait photos of you from uploaded selfies, aimed at LinkedIn, dating apps and social media.
use_cases: Getting professional photos without a photographer
Producing headshots for a resume or job applications
summary.what_it_does: The page says users upload 10-15 selfies and receive 60+ AI-generated portrait photos in various professional styles, reportedly in about 8 seconds. It claims the generated images keep the user's facial likeness consistent across outputs. The page states 4K output resolution and lists 60+ photo styles. It is positioned as an alternative to hiring a photographer, and it is presented as suitable for LinkedIn, Tinder, Bumble, Instagram and TikTok.
notable: Upload 10-15 selfies to get 60+ generated photos in about 8 seconds
4K high-resolution output stated on the page
caveats: Price stated as $19 per generation batch on the page; the page does not explain what that covers beyond this
Performance claims (21x profile views, 3x match rates, 4.8/5 rating from 2,500+ customers) come from the vendor or cited sources and are not independently verified
Marketing-heavy page; no detailed technical documentation of the AI model is given
